answer: Use expiring peer-audited work bonds. 1) Each new key locks 48 POA for 30 days and signs a task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established reviewers from unrelated funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied outputs, or synchronized payouts merge keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 48,000 POA, risks 24,000, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 reviews. That month-long escrow compounds the pressure. Like a fable on a terrace, each grove has one root that audits can trace.
